thag14.1:1.1: Terasanipāto niṭṭhito. CUDDASANIPĀTO. Yadā ahaṃ pabbajito agārasmā anagāriyaṃ nābhijānāmi saṃkappaṃ anariyaṃ dosasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
thag14.1:2.1: ime haññantu vajjhantu dukkhaṃ pappontu pāṇino saṃkappaṃ nābhijānāmi imasmiṃ dīghamantare. || ||
thag14.1:3.1: mettañ ca abhijānāmi appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ anupubbaṃ paricitaṃ yathā buddhena desitaṃ. || ||
thag14.1:4.1: sabbamitto sabbasakho sabbabhūtānukampako mettaṃ cittañ ca bhāvemi abyāpajjharato sadā. || ||
thag14.1:5.1: asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppaṃ cittaṃ āmodayām' ahaṃ, brahmavihāraṃ bhāvemi akāpurisasevitaṃ. || ||
thag14.1:6.1: avitakkaṃ samāpanno sammāsambuddhasāvako ariyena tuṇhibhāvena upeto hoti tāvade. || ||
thag14.1:7.1: yathāpi pabbato selo acalo suppatiṭṭhito, evaṃ mohakkhayā bhikkhu pabbato va na vedhati. || ||
thag14.1:8.1: anaṅgaṇassa posassa niccaṃ sucigavesino vālaggamattaṃ pāpassa abbhāmattaṃ va khāyati. || ||
thag14.1:9.1: nagaraṃ yathā paccantaṃ guttaṃ santarabāhiraṃ, evaṃ gopetha attānaṃ, khaṇo ve mā upaccagā.
thag14.1:14.1: sampādeth' appamādena, esā me anusāsanī; handāhaṃ parinibbissaṃ, vippamutto 'mhi sabbadhīti. || || Revato thero.
